scope: Actual local development terminal candidates, independently launched under ConPTY. No production backend switch.

conditions.launcher: TerminalAppsProbe.exe, built independently from the shared BoundaryProbe.exe
conditions.profile: Fresh disposable AppContainer and new tools/work/out directories for every run.
conditions.environment: Clean base environment; only explicitly supplied local application settings are added.
conditions.networkScope: Zero network capabilities. Claude default onboarding attempted its own startup connectivity check and reported ENOTFOUND; no model prompt or login was submitted.

results.requiredConfiguration: NoProfile; explicitly mount only the granted work and tools directories as Cage: and CageTools: PSDrives, then enter Cage:.
results.defaultFailure: Without the PSDrive bootstrap, PowerShell could evaluate commands and Chinese input but failed to resolve the external helper through the filesystem provider. No volume-root ACL was changed to fix it.
results.limitations: System shell and fixture commands only; arbitrary PowerShell modules and external applications are not covered.

results.requiredConfiguration: --preserve-symlinks-main --preserve-symlinks; external child uses inherited ConPTY stdio
results.defaultEntryControl: Default file entry still failed at lstat of the volume root when staged under a fresh C-drive user-temp directory. Moving disks did not remove the need for the tested entry options.
results.limitations: No npm download, arbitrary native addon, full package ecosystem or default captured-pipe child stdio compatibility claim.

results.requiredConfiguration: Explicit -ClaudeOfflineGateway fixture: local settings force the gateway onboarding path with a reserved, nonfunctional placeholder URL. No credentials or actual service are configured.
results.exitPath: Controller closed the terminal Job; process exit, output drain and profile cleanup were observed.
results.defaultFailure: An empty default profile rendered the welcome screen, then its mandatory first-run connectivity preflight reported ENOTFOUND before login selection. This remains a separate failure, not a default offline pass.
results.intermediateControl: The gateway fixture reached the theme screen, but two Ctrl+C inputs did not terminate that onboarding page. The final verifier explicitly tests closing the terminal instead of calling this graceful exit.
results.limitations: No logged-in prompt, model response, Claude tool execution, credentials persistence, session restore or authenticated gateway behavior was tested.

results.staging: Native git.exe plus adjacent DLLs only; no real config, templates, hooks, credentials, user profiles or portable temporary data copied.
results.failedCommand: git init in a disposable local project
results.diagnostic: unable to get current working directory: Permission denied
results.newCDriveFixtureControl: Same initialization failure as the workspace-drive fixture; no existing directory ACL changed.
results.interpretation: The failure is narrowed to DOS-volume-name path resolution rather than inability to read the granted working directory. Git's mingw_getcwd uses the failing normalized DOS-name query. This does not yet identify the exact Windows object denying that conversion.
results.nextBoundary: An application compatibility change or a narrowly designed directory service is needed; the unmodified Git binary was not patched and host permissions were not widened.

verificationNotes: The original Claude capture removed horizontal cursor movement and therefore missed words separated by ConPTY CSI 1 C. The capture now preserves those spaces; the transport still forwards raw bytes unchanged.
Passed PowerShell and Node workloads were not rerun after unrelated Claude/Git diagnostics.
Temporary profiles were removed after each run. Application copies and test results remain in their new fixture directories for inspection.
All conclusions here are for ordinary AC. They do not override independent LPAC failures or GUI/browser results.

reproducibleEntry.prepareOnly: -PrepareOnly emits prepared.json with standard terminal-rpc arguments and an open message for the existing host-owned workbench adapter.
reproducibleEntry.pathDiagnostic: TerminalAppsProbe.exe path-diagnostic <new fixture below its build directory>
